Resource Library — v4.9

Training Plan → My Library: select a Training Plan to view only its linked resources and forms. The library includes a searchable plan selector, batch/version selection, resource search, type/day filters, a resource table and day-wise cards.

Role behavior

  • Schoolnet Admin: browse reusable master configurations or saved batch versions; upload files, bulk upload Excel with files, reuse resources and manage permissions.
  • Trainer: view plans used by assigned batches and the resources from their saved versions. Upload/repository management requires the existing permission grant.
  • Trainee: view their assigned batch library, released resources and forms. Complete a released form through Assessments & feedback.
  • Other administrators: browse libraries of batches within their assigned project/state/school scope.

Availability and history

Batch libraries use captured plan assignments. Editing/removing a mapping on the current master does not remove that historical assignment. Release starts on the linked training day; resources remain available through the project end date. Explicit previously configured propagation continues to apply. Project-specific content stays within its project; common content can be reused when linked to the selected plan. Administration preview access is labelled separately.

Try it

  1. Log in as A1 (Demo@123) and open Resource Library. Select TP-0001 to see all ten sample mappings.
  2. Choose Batch B-DEMO-01 to see its saved configuration. Filter Day 2 or Presentation; search Teacher Training Handbook.
  3. Log in as A6 to see their assigned batch library. Future releases and expired-project resources have disabled actions; released forms open the assessment workflow.
  4. Log in as A5 for the trainer’s assigned library. An administrator can grant upload permission using Permissions & approved formats.

Verification

41 targeted library assertions pass for plan selection, name/type/day filters, saved versions, availability, expiry, role scope, historical mappings and cross-project content restrictions. Existing resource and complete POC regression checks pass. Tests use non-browser fixtures; real browser layout, navigation, IndexedDB and XLSX parsing remain unverified.
